svg.title: Local fiducials beside a BGA
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of a 0.8 mm-pitch BGA with 144 balls on a board. Each inner ball connects by a short trace to a via between the balls; the outer ring of balls escapes with traces straight out. The BGA has a silkscreen outline, a pin-1 dot and its reference designator U1. A local fiducial, FID1 and FID2, sits just outside two opposite corners of the BGA. Each fiducial is a 1 mm copper dot in a 2 mm mask opening. The board's own fiducials are at its corners, outside this view.

g.text: At two opposite corners of the BGA
Inner balls fan out, under the mask
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm. 0.8 mm-pitch BGA, 12 × 12 balls.
Fiducials: 1 mm copper dot in a 2 mm mask opening.
The board's own fiducials sit at its corners, outside this view.
